programme.desc: Stop. Wonderblock Stop is Go's new best friend! She loves to think things through. Stop shows her new friends how taking a moment to reflect can help solve all sorts of problems.

programme.title: Love Monster
programme.desc: Woodworking Day. Love Monster crafts a special toy plane from wood for himself, but he is worried Tiniest Fluffiest Bunny and Bad Idea Puppy will break it when he shares it with them.

programme.title: Hey Duggee Songs
programme.desc: Heads, Shoulders, Knees and Toes. A Hey Duggee take on the classic Head, Shoulders, Knees and Toes tune, sung by Lord Fingal, Hedgley, the Old Deers and Eugene.

programme.title: Playtime Towers
programme.desc: Pockets. Bella and Lift visit Patch in the Cloud Kitchen. He has found a tiny mouse in his pocket, which reminds him of a tasty treat recipe to make with the Playtimers - pocket mouse pitta!

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Dandelion. Children's animation. After blowing the seeds off some dandelions, Bing decides to take one to Sula. Bing negotiates many windy hazards to keep the dandelion safe.

programme.title: Yakka Dee!
programme.desc: Dog. Preschool series about words. Dee encourages a friend to say 'dog', and we go on a whirlwind word adventure exploring how dogs look and what they do.

programme.title: Lu & the Bally Bunch
programme.desc: Baby Barnaby. Barnaby plays the baby in a game of family.

programme.title: Piggy Builders
programme.desc: Captain Keith. Keith dreams of a pirate adventure. The Piggies build a wheeled ship and sail across Fine Forest for treasure, but Wilf plans to steal it!

programme.title: Twirlywoos
programme.desc: Open and Close. Stop-motion preschool programme about the adventures of four inquisitive Twirlywoos. The Twirlywoos open and close stage curtains while a singer is performing!

programme.title: Something Special: We're All Friends
programme.desc: Let's Pretend. Justin and his friend play pizza restaurants, and Mr Tumble knits a jumper.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: Things. Preschool series. The Teletubbies find different uses for their favourite things, and a child in Tummy Tales makes a seaside picture out of lots of things.

programme.title: The Baby Club
programme.desc: Cardboard Tube. Nigel and Baby Bear invite babies and their grown-ups to explore cardboard tubes through discovery, play, song and story.

programme.title: Maddie & Triggs
programme.desc: Spoons. When Maddie and Triggs realise that all the teaspoons have gone missing from the kitchen, Maddie figures out a surprisingly musical way to get them back where they belong.

programme.title: Dylan's Playtime Adventures
programme.desc: Sports Shop Owner. Dylan the sports shop owner wants to sell all the merchandise in his store. But when a five-armed customer comes in, he's going to have to pull out all the stops!

programme.title: Kiri and Lou
programme.desc: One Summer's Morning. Lou goes for an unexpected ride while fast asleep on the back of a giant sloth.

programme.title: Vegesaurs
programme.desc: Rollercoaster Brocs. Split is terrified of sliding down the necks of giant Broccolisaurus.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Chickenrat. It's bedtime, and Bingo can't remember where she left her beloved Floppy.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: The Delivery Badge. Chipmunk is cycling one day delivering his packages when he hits a rock and his trike falls apart! He has so many packages to deliver - what is he going to do now?

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club
programme.desc: Campfire Choir. Today at Squirrel Club, there are all sorts of comparisons to learn - from small to smallest, hungry to hungriest, and Duggee to Duggiest!

programme.title: Roots and Fruits
programme.desc: Strawberry. Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's Strawberry, who used to be insecure but now can't wait to celebrate herself and sing her song, See the Seeds!

programme.title: Timmy Time
programme.desc: Timmy the Builder. When the class builds dens, Otus offers to help Timmy with his, but Timmy is too proud to accept.

programme.title: Time for School
programme.desc: Autumn Walk. Jud, Jessica and their class visit a local park to collect leaves for an art project. Caretaker, Mr Clever, clears up the fallen leaves with the help of some super sweepers!

programme.title: Big Cook Little Cook
programme.desc: Larry the Lighthouse Keeper. Jen has brought in her special marble collection to show Small.

programme.title: Aneeshwar and Lizzie Go Wild
programme.desc: Vulture and Brittlestar. Aneeshwar and Lizzie meet two amazing animals and reveal a surprising connection between them in the wild. This time, it's vultures and brittlestars.

programme.title: What's in Your Bag?
programme.desc: Bharatanatyam Dancer. Bharatanatyam dancer Suhani tells us all about her ghungroo, or anklet, and why she loves to wear it.

programme.title: Dog Squad
programme.desc: Mission: Birthday Cake. Guide dog Kika and Dr Amit visit the supermarket to pick up a surprise birthday cake. But the party hats have been moved! Kika must use all her powers to find them.

programme.title: Maddie's Do You Know?
programme.desc: Digestion and Meringue. Maddie learns what happens to the food we eat and discovers how meringue is made.

programme.title: Yakka Dee!
programme.desc: Yo-Yo. Dee encourages a friend to say 'yo-yo', and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. We see a stripy yo-yo, some spotty yo-yos, a flashy yo-yo and even a peepo yo-yo!

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: Double Trouble. Children's animation. One explores the Double Dungeon of Doom by doubling herself. Learn how to double and halve numbers up to 8 with the Numberblocks.

programme.title: Alphablocks
programme.desc: Fit. Educational fun. H needs a helping hand to heave herself up the hill, so I turns instructor for an incredible workout.

programme.title: Wonderblocks
programme.desc: Here We Go Again. How can Toad get his rail cart to move quickly enough to meet his friends? Go and Stop discover that Again can provide the answer.

programme.title: Colourblocks
programme.desc: Pick a Partner. The Colourblocks enjoy a dance, but which colours make the best partners? Learn about similar and complementary colours.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: The Action Hero Badge. The Squirrels learn about an action hero called Jet Rocket who always saves the day by smashing and crashing things. But there are other ways to save the day!

programme.title: Yukee
programme.desc: Skip Skip Hurray. When Rapper Bushy T visits the garden, can his hip-hop beats help poor Stripes master Yukee's skipping rope and join in the fun?

programme.title: Something Special: We're All Friends
programme.desc: Imaginary Journey. Educational series using Makaton sign language. All aboard for a steam train adventure with Justin and his friends, while Mr Tumble zooms off into space!

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: Taking Turns. Preschool comedy and education. Laa-Laa and Po take turns to ride Po's scooter, and then they take turns to play with the Tiddlytubbies.

programme.title: Andy's Prehistoric Adventures
programme.desc: Basilosaurus and Barnacles. Preschool adventure series. Andy goes on another time-travelling adventure to collect barnacles from a prehistoric ocean for his new museum display.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: Waffle and the Good Dog. Preschool comedy drama series. Jess hopes the Essam family's well-behaved dog, Baxter, will teach Waffle how to be good, but Waffle has other ideas...

programme.title: Topsy and Tim
programme.desc: Camping Weekend. Live-action children's show. Topsy and Tim are very excited - they are going on a camping trip straight after school with Mummy and Dad.

programme.title: Raa Raa the Noisy Lion
programme.desc: Raa Raa's Naptime Story. Stop-frame animation featuring Raa Raa, who lives in the Jingly Jangly Jungle. Raa Raa wants to make the noises to go with a story, but they are too loud.

programme.title: The Game Catchers
programme.desc: Snowy Tic-Tac-Toe. The Game Catchers arrive on a Christmas-themed planet to play super tic-tac-toe.

programme.title: Octonauts: Above & Beyond
programme.desc: Snowshoe Hares. When winter comes early in Canada, the Octonauts help some hares with their camouflage.

programme.title: Big Lizard
programme.desc: The Sea Meteorite! When a meteorite splashes into the sea, Dad and Cosima cause problems by claiming it in the name of science, against the wishes of the sea creatures.

programme.title: Supertato
programme.desc: Double Trouble. Supertato and Carrot are looking for ice and think Evil Pea has become kind by giving them some. They soon realise it's not Evil Pea after all.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: The Maze Badge. Animated preschool series. The Squirrels work hard to help Duggee clean his workshop but when they finish they can't find him. Oh! They've built a maze around him!

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: The Tale of Mr Tod's Trap. Animated series. Peter, Benjamin and Lily are tempted by a mysterious hoard of radishes.

programme.title: Time for School
programme.desc: Kindness Day. It's Kindness Day, and the children are practising being extra kind to each other at school. Sam helps Solomon at lunchtime, and Isla helps Bryn on the climbing frame.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: Shark 'n' Ride. A shark in Swoppiton? Mojo and Bo go on a fishing trip to find out more!

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Unicorse. Bluey's bedtime story is disturbed by Unicorse, the most annoying hand puppet in the world.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Swim School. Pleasing Big Fish class instructor Margaret is proving difficult for Mum, Dad and Bingo.

programme.title: Piripenguins
programme.desc: Nugget's Muddy Mishap. When Nugget's teddy gets accidentally washed, the Piris try to recreate its unique smell.

programme.title: Dodge's Pup School

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog

programme.title: The Swimmer
programme.desc: (1968) Burt Lancaster stars as the angst-ridden middle-aged man who decides to swim home via neighbour's pools in Frank and Eleanor Perry's superb allegorical drama.

programme.title: The Man from Colorado
programme.desc: (1948) Western. When a sadistic Union colonel (Glenn Ford) becomes a federal judge after the Civil War, his friend (William Holden) takes the deputy job to try and temper his actions.

programme.title: Gift Horse
programme.desc: (1952) War drama. Trevor Howard plays the captain of an ageing US warship, gifted to the British navy, which is chosen to lead the raid on Saint-Nazaire in 1942. With Richard Attenborough.

programme.title: The Desert Fox
programme.desc: (1951) Drama. James Mason stars in Henry Hathaway's sympathetic portrait of Field Marshal Erwin Rommel in the final years of his life during the Second World War. With Jessica Tandy.

programme.title: Independence Day: Resurgence
programme.desc: (2016) Sci-fi blockbuster sequel starring Jeff Goldblum. Twenty years after Earth repelled a devastating alien invasion, the extraterrestrials return to finish the job.

programme.title: Commando
programme.desc: (1985) Thriller starring Arnold Schwarzenegger. To free his kidnapped daughter, an ex US commando must agree to assassinate a South American president. But he's not as pliant as he seems...

programme.title: Dead Man's Shoes
programme.desc: (2004) Shane Meadows' thriller starring Paddy Considine, Gary Stretch and Toby Kebbell. An ex-soldier is bent on revenge against the drug dealers who cruelly tormented his younger brother.

programme.title: Joyland
programme.desc: (2022) Poignant familial drama about the pressures felt by those who don't slot neatly into the mores of Pakistan's strictly patriarchal, judgemental society. In Urdu, Punjabi/subs.

programme.title: A Lawless Street
programme.desc: (1955) A non-stop romp of a western from director Joseph H Lewis. In the town of Medicine Bend, only Marshal Calem Ware can keep its citizens from falling into complete lawlessness.

programme.title: The Blue Lamp
programme.desc: (1950) Gritty noir thriller from Ealing Studios. A rookie PC hunts a vicious killer across blitz-battered London. With Jimmy Hanley, Dirk Bogarde and Jack Warner as PC George Dixon.

programme.title: Anastasia
programme.desc: (1956) Historical drama. The Oscar-winning Ingrid Bergman stars as an amnesiac refugee who Yul Brynner tries to pass off as the daughter of the murdered Tsar of Russia, Nicholas II.

programme.title: The Old Man and the Gun
programme.desc: (2018) Crime biopic. Robert Redford stars as charming 74-year-old robber Forrest Tucker. He's still robbing banks when he falls for farmer Jewel (Sissy Spacek). But the cops still want him.

programme.title: Tombstone
programme.desc: (1993) Western. Kurt Russell stars in the story of legendary Wild West lawman Wyatt Earp told through the medium of the moustache. With Val Kilmer as 'Doc' Holliday and Charlton Heston.

programme.title: The Anderson Tapes (1971)
programme.desc: 1971. Crime Thriller. Directed by Sidney Lumet. Starring Martin Balsam, Dyan Cannon, Sean Connery, Christopher Walken. A habitual criminal looks for funding to set up his next robbery.

programme.title: Star Treatment Show
programme.desc: 1979 Southern Televisions version of 'Opportunity Knocks!' This week starring: Greg Bonham. Young entertainers are given a chance to showcase their talent in their own production. (S1, E05)

programme.title: The Heritage Chart Show with Mike Read
programme.desc: A TOTP style TV Show for Heritage Artists based on the Heritage Chart which is voted on in over 80 countries. Songs you love from popular artists, live and on video with the odd interview.

programme.title: They Live
programme.desc: 1988. Sci-fi Horror. Directed by John Carpenter. Stars Roddy Piper, Keith David & Meg Foster. A homeless drifter discovers a pair of sunglasses capable of showing the world the way it truly is.

programme.title: The Spiritualist
programme.desc: 1948. Thriller. Director: Bernard Vorhaus. Stars Turhan Bey, Lynn Bari & Cathy O'Donnell. Christine thinks she can hear her late husband calling out of the surf on the beach one night.

programme.title: The Hangman Waits
programme.desc: 1947. Thriller. Director: A. Barr-Smith. Stars John Turnbull & Hylton Allen. This 1947 semi-documentary style featurette is a story of grisly murders by a cinema organist.

programme.title: Johnny Ringo
programme.desc: Kid With A Gun. Directed by Aaron Spelling and starring Don Durant. Johnny investigates Josie Wilkins' report that her father was murdered, but can't find a body to support her claim.

programme.title: SOS Pacific
programme.desc: 1959. Drama. Directed by Guy Green. Starring Richard Attenborough, Pier Angeli & John Gregson. A flying boat fire forces its passengers, including a prisoner, to make a disastrous water landing.

programme.title: What's On TPTV With Noel
programme.desc: Founder of Talking Pictures TV and one half of the Footage Detectives, Noel Cronin, shares shows and films not to be missed throughout October.

programme.title: Out of Town
programme.desc: 21st Anniversary Programme. 1981. Skate fishing, traction engines, gun dogs and a dancing horse all feature in this special compilation celebrating '21 years of gossiping about the countryside'.

programme.title: Man Accused
programme.desc: 1959. Drama. Director: Montgomery Tully. Stars Ronald Howard, Carol Marsh & Ian Fleming. After being arrested for robbery and murder, Jenson breaks jail to find the real criminals to turn them in.

programme.title: The Break
programme.desc: 1963. Crime Drama. Director: Lance Comfort. When writer Greg Parker (Tony Britton) goes on holiday, little does he expect to be lodging in the same B&B as an escaped murderer (William Lucas).

programme.title: Look At Life On the Map
programme.desc: 1960. A look at the Ordnance Survey and the maps it has been producing for over two centuries, told in fascinating detail.

programme.title: Dixon of Dock Green
programme.desc: Harry's Back. 1974. Stars Jack Warner, Lee Montague & Jonathan Adams. Harry Simpson is back from Spain. The same Harry whom everyone thinks is wonderful. Everyone except for Andy Crawford.

programme.title: The Dark Man
programme.desc: 1951. Drama. Director: Jeffrey Dell. Stars Maxwell Reed, Edward Underdown & Natasha Parry. An inspector hunts a killer who is looking for an actress who witnessed him commit murder.

programme.title: Doctor Morelle
programme.desc: 1949. Mystery. Directed by Godfrey Grayson. Stars Valentine Dyall, Julia Lang & Hugh Griffith. When a young woman mysteriously disappears, her friend turns to Doctor Morelle to help investigate.

programme.title: Look At Life Sea Horses
programme.desc: 1962. A look at the essential part of a port - tugboats, without which any big port would come to a standstill.

programme.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
programme.desc: Cabin in Beverly Hills. 1964. Stars Buddy Ebsen, Irene Ryan & Donna Douglas. Granny is homesick so Mr Drysdale has a replica made of Jed's old cabin as a surprise for her birthday.

programme.title: Scotland Yard
programme.desc: 1960. The Last Train. Directed by Geoffrey Muller. Starring Russell Napier, Norman Johns and Lisa Daniely. Duggan investigates a murder in the London Underground. (S1, E33)

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: The Mission. 1960. Stars Dan Blocker, Henry Hull & John Dehner. Hoss befriends Charlie Trent, a man who went from top Army scout to town drunk after he led his troops into a massacre.

programme.title: The Vise
programme.desc: Lucky Man. 1954. Stars Leslie Phillips, Ann Stephens & Colin Gordon. A junior diplomat wins the love of Lily, but her father is sponsoring a theory that marriage is the enemy of civilisation.

programme.title: The Footage Detectives
programme.desc: We've got an exclusive interview with Michael Wilding, Anna Neagle & Herbert Wilcox! We look behind the scenes of The Western Electric Company in the 40s and learn about the benefits of the beach.

programme.title: The Hound of the Baskervilles
programme.desc: 2002. Drama. Director: David Attwood. Stars Richard Roxburgh, Ian Hart & Richard E. Grant. Sherlock Holmes and Dr Watson investigate after being told an heir's estate is plagued by a ghostly dog.

programme.title: Night of the Big Heat
programme.desc: 1967. Sci-Fi. Directed by Terence Fisher. Starring Christopher Lee, Peter Cushing & Patrick Allen. A heatwave forces the atmosphere to boil. It falls on Godfrey Hanson to discover the reason.

programme.title: Ruth Ellis and the Mystery Lover
